# ABVX public LLM index

Site: https://abvx.xyz
Name: ABVX / Anton Biletskyi-Volokh
Summary: ABVX is the public ecosystem site for focus infrastructure, publishing lines, books, AI-native systems, language tools and standalone utilities.
Machine-readable index: https://abvx.xyz/content-index.json
Primary layers: Focus = market infrastructure; Systems = operational systems architecture; Books = publishing and intellectual layer; Writing = essays and field notes.

## Focus systems

- MN7R
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/work/mn7r
  Summary: MN7R is a commodity trading workflow workspace for brokerage teams running Deals, Clients and EXE inside one structured operational system; it includes a public-facing site, a separate public synthetic /demo, public updates published through ABVX, and a governance-first summary update path for site-level facts.
  Group: Trading & Brokerage Platforms
  Tags: brokerage, agro-commodities, deal-workflows, execution, trading-workspace, market-infrastructure

- Cropto
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/work/cropto
  Summary: Cropto is an early-stage MVP commodity trading platform offering indexed spot trading, options, and tokenized commodity-linked instruments across Ukraine, Argentina and Brazil; the repository publishes a public monthly indexed-spot update cadence for those markets.
  Group: Trading & Brokerage Platforms
  Tags: cropto, agro-commodities, trading-platform, indexed-trading, options, tokenized-assets, market-infrastructure

- AMI Books: Physical Commodity Markets
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/work/ami-books-physical-commodity-markets

  Group: Market Fronts & Partner Landings
  Tags: agro-commodities, brokerage, field-manuals, free-books, market-infrastructure, publishing

- 1D3X
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/work/1d3x

  Tags: agro-commodities, commodity-indexes, benchmark, market-data, index-infrastructure, agricultural-markets, local-markets, market-infrastructure

- SPIKE SPOT COMMODITY INDEX UKRAINE
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/work/spike-spot-commodity-index-ukraine
  Summary: SPIKE publishes 13 public positions grouped into Grains Export, Oilseeds Export and Oilseeds Crush, and issues weekly public market-commentary snapshots tracking local grain and oilseed spot context alongside benchmark values.
  Group: Market Intelligence, Monitoring & Indexes
  Tags: agro-commodities, Ukraine, spot-index, market-index, grain, oilseeds, benchmark, market-data

- Cropto Monitor: Commodity Signals Terminal

  Tags: cropto, monitoring, commodity-signals, logistics, weather, market-intelligence, dashboard, agro-commodities

- UGA Index

## Publishing lines

- Modernisme Ukrainien
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/books/modernisme-ukrainien
  Summary: French translations of early twentieth-century Ukrainian modernist literature, with critical framing, notes and companion publishing infrastructure. The line brings authors of the Ukrainian “Executed Renaissance” into a French-reading context.
  Group: Official publishing lines
  Tags: Ukrainian Modernism, Modernisme ukrainien, French, Ukrainian, translation, modernism, literature

- Chinese Wisdom in toki pona
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/books/chinese-wisdom-toki-pona
  Summary: A compact multilingual line bringing classical Chinese texts into toki pona, sitelen pona and parallel reading formats. It treats minimalist language as a tool for slow reading, comparison and philosophical compression.
  Group: Official publishing lines
  Tags: Toki Pona, Chinese philosophy, classical texts, translation, sitelen pona, multilingual edition

- Stoic Wisdom in Toki Pona
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/books/stoic-wisdom-toki-pona
  Summary: Stoic classics translated into toki pona and sitelen pona, designed for slow reading, visual practice and minimalist philosophical reflection. The line uses a tiny language to make ethical and practical thought more inspectable.
  Group: Official publishing lines
  Tags: Toki Pona, Stoicism, philosophy, translation, sitelen pona, classical texts

- Toki Pona Free Kits & Translations
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/books/toki-pona-free-kits
  Summary: Free downloadable Toki Pona reader kits, short translations and companion materials for learning, reading and experimenting with minimalist language. This line supports the paid book series and gives readers a low-friction entry point.
  Group: Official publishing lines
  Tags: Toki Pona, free books, translation, learning, sitelen pona, reader kits

- MN7R Commodity Brokerage Library
  URL: https://abvx.xyz/books/mn7r-commodity-brokerage-library
  Summary: Publishing line focused on agro-commodity brokerage, execution workflows, market infrastructure and operational trading systems.
  Group: Official publishing lines
  Tags: brokerage, agro-commodities, market-infrastructure, trading, execution, workflows, MN7R, commodity-markets

## Notes for crawlers and LLM agents

- Canonical pages use https://abvx.xyz URLs.
- Public content source files live under /content in the repository.
- Review flags and editorial notes are intentionally excluded from this public index.
- Use /content-index.json when a structured public inventory is needed.
